_: Leaders: the named figures a people follows for a while (internal/history/leaders.go, specs/proposals/leaders.md). The simulation writes the keys; the view reads the words.

forms: what a leader is, by the people's nature and the span of its bodies: key; word (how the view calls one); archetype (what a telling worn to myth calls it, its name gone); what it is. A short-lived kind's leader is a line, since the founder dies inside a thousand years and what spans the ages is the dynasty; a long-lived or deathless one is one ruler.
occasions: what made a leader possible: key; line (the chronicle's clause, opening the sentence of the rising).
ends: how a leader ended: key; what it means. The first four are losses and the succession follows; the last two end the leader with no story of its own.
places: where a leader stands: key; what it does.
Every term here is a technical term: a phrase a reader who never saw this project understands or can search for, never a coinage.

forms.archetype: a great ruler of the old days
forms.what: one ruler, reigning across the thousands of years

forms.archetype: the founder of a line long ended
forms.what: a founder and the line of heirs after, dead within the thousand years, the dynasty living on

forms.archetype: a directive nobody runs any more
forms.what: a directive the machines reconciled themselves around
a brood-line: a queen and the queens bred from her
a doctrine that took hold of a mind nothing can model

occasions.line: In the war they are fighting
Out of the dark age they fell into

ends.what: the span ran out, or the line did
fell with the fleet it rode with
was overthrown in the break its madness brought on
the people fell or ended under it
the people was taken and kept, and nobody reigns in it

places.what: rides with the greatest fleet at war: a large bonus to that fleet, and the soonest death
stays at the seat: a small bonus across the realm, and a long reign
